details.source_description: Project Miner is located on 400 acres and delivering a state of the art data center complex. Construction completion is approximately July 2028. During construction mobile cranes will be used. Obstruction and frequency evaluations have already been completed for permanent structures. No filing was required as the buildings do not exceed 60ft. Frequency was filed under 2026-ASW-14687-OE with no determination of hazard
